text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Warisan Kebangsaan

(Perisytiharan Orang Hidup sebagai Warisan Kebangsaan) 2016.

Perisytiharan Warisan Kebangsaan

2. Orang yang dinamakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

Warisan Kebangsaan dalam bidang yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (2).

JADUAL

(1) (2)

Nama Bidang

Saad bin Taib Mek Mulung

Romli bin Mahamud Awang Batil

Dato' Md Aripin bin Said Lagu-lagu rakyat

Maznah anak Unyan Penganyaman tradisional Orang Asli

Mathew Ngau Jau Muzik Sape

Dibuat 27 Disember 2015

[JWN.PP.600/3/51/1/3; PN(PU2)652/XII]

DATO' SERI MOHAMED NAZRI BIN TAN SRI ABDUL AZIZ

Menteri Pelancongan dan Kebudayaan

NATIONAL HERITAGE ACT 2005

NATIONAL HERITAGE (DECLARATION OF LIVING PERSON AS A

NATIONAL HERITAGE) ORDER 2016

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 67(1) of

the National Heritage Act 2005 [Act 645], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the National Heritage

(Declaration of Living Person as a National Heritage) Order 2016.

Declaration of National Heritage

2. The persons named in column (1) of the Schedule are declared as

National Heritage in the fields specified in column (2).

SCHEDULE

(1) (2)

Names Fields

Saad bin Taib Mek Mulung

Romli bin Mahamud Awang Batil

Made 27 December 2015

DATO' SERI MOHAMED NAZRI BIN TAN SRI ABDUL AZIZ

Minister of Tourism and Culture
